cluster_readings.reason: In the enlarged ashrei84-cluster.png, the mark under the first lamed is a patah bar with a two-dot colon beside it, the same shape as the hataf-patah elsewhere on the line. It is not the bare two dots (sheva) under the yod of the same word. The p.2 printing of the same verse on s8 shows the same shape. Heidenheim regularly puts hataf on the first of two identical consonants, so this matches his practice. This was read from the actual cluster, not carried over from the Halleluyah ruling.

In ashrei145-cluster.png, the first lamed has the same patah-plus-colon shape as the hataf-patah under the alef of the same word and under the alef of אֲבָרְכֶךָּ. It is not the bare sheva seen under the final כ of שִׁמְךָ. On s8, line 2 has the same form.
